home.heroTitle: We Engineer the Systems Behind Better Business.
home.heroSubtitle: From your first website to intelligent enterprise operations, SERK Technologies Group designs and develops practical digital solutions for organizations ready to work smarter. We combine software engineering, thoughtful design, responsible AI and deep attention to real-world workflows — starting in Ethiopia, built for a wider world.
home.whySerkSubtitle: At Serk, we pair real industry know-how with practical AI. The result is software that feels made for you, because it is.

about.title: Engineering Sovereign Technology for Heavy Enterprise
about.subtitle: SERK Technologies Group pairs real African industry know-how with practical software engineering, cloud architecture, and responsible AI.
about.mission: To engineer trustworthy, high-performing software systems that elevate African industry and empower organizations to operate autonomously.
about.vision: A self-reliant technological ecosystem where Ethiopian and African enterprises run on software built for their exact workflows.
about.storyParagraph1: Serk Group is a software company building AI-integrated systems for the industries that keep the world running. We design, build and support products for construction, healthcare, retail and finance — starting from practical problems on the ground and turning them into software that teams actually enjoy using.
about.storyParagraph2: We believe the most valuable technology is not the loudest, but the most reliable. That is why our products pair modern AI capabilities with rock-solid, production-tested software engineering and honest disclosures about maturity.
